statement: https://www.topgolf.com/us/ redirects to the canonical non-www URL https://topgolf.com/us/.
The public PLAY navigation links to /us/experience/.
Cleveland is the closest observed Topgolf venue to downtown Toronto at about 311.3 km straight-line distance; Avon is about 324.5 km and Detroit-Auburn Hills about 333.9 km.
evidence_refs: observed venue coordinates and local distance calculation

statement: Cleveland site 63 offered September 5, 2026 at 2:00 PM for four players with 120 minutes available and recommended at $88, 90 minutes available at $66, and 60 minutes unavailable.
Saturday pricing from noon to 4 PM was $44 per hour per bay, excluded sales tax, and could include a one-time new-player membership fee.
Booking sign-in uses mobile-number SMS verification with a country selector, phone field, SEND CODE action, Terms link, and Privacy link.

Public JavaScript exposes guest checkout, player lookup, attendee identity fields, accessibility request, terms acknowledgement, payment summary, sandbox-incompatible wallet choices, confirmation, manage, edit, cancel, refund, failure, retry, and session-expiry states.
Final source tax, membership fee, checkout total, and confirmation rendering were unavailable because source checkout effects were prohibited.
